## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that solves it.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally.
- [ ] I tested the affected interaction with a keyboard.
- [ ] I checked light and dark appearances when the change is visual.
- [ ] I checked a narrow viewport when layout is affected.
- [ ] I checked reduced motion when animation is affected.

## Visual evidence

Add screenshots or a short recording for visible changes. Remove this section
when the pull request has no visual effect.

## Component checklist

- [ ] Public props and types remain intentional and documented.
- [ ] Catalogue content, preview controls, usage, and accessibility notes are updated.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` includes the user-visible change under `Unreleased`.
- [ ] No unavailable package, API, compatibility, or accessibility claim was added.
